title: Chapter 62 Agreeing To Send Troops
content:
Chapter 62 Agreeing To Send Troops

Seeing such a situation, the Rat Lord was heartbroken. The mission had failed and his fate could be imagined.

"Meng, may I say a few words?"

Wu Qing stood up at this time and asked Meng to show respect.

He nodded sharply.

"This Rat Clan Lord, I would like to ask, must the 50,000 elite soldiers requested by the Tengu Clan be sent out at once?"

Wu Qing looked at the Rat Clan Lord and asked loudly.

"There are no specific requirements. It just requires that the number of elites participating in the battle should not be less than 50,000."

The Rat Tribe Lord had no hope of completing the mission and just wanted to stay alive for the time being, so he answered Wu Qing's questions very honestly.

"Do you think this will work? We agreed to send troops to participate in the war, but due to objective reasons, we cannot send so many troops at once. We will send troops in three times, and a total of 50,000 elite troops will be sent to participate in the war. How about it?"

Wu Qing expressed his thoughts.

The Rat Tribe Lord was overjoyed. He heard Wu Qing agree to send troops to participate in the war, which meant that he still had hope to complete the mission.

Meng was thoughtful about Wu Qing's words. The other lords were surprised and didn't know why Wu Qing stood up and opposed Meng.

"Do you really agree to send troops? I'm not sure whether the troops can be sent in batches, but at least 50,000 elite troops must be sent before the end of the battle. Is there any problem with this?"

The Rat Tribe Lord asked Wu Qing with some anticipation.

"The duration of the great battle should be relatively long. There is no problem in sending 50,000 elite troops during this period."

Wu Qing readily agreed to this request.

"Okay! As long as we can provide 50,000 elite soldiers, I will definitely help with other conditions!"

The Rat Tribe Lord saw the dawn of completing his mission and worked hard in front of Wu Qing.

"I still have some detailed requirements. If they can be met, we will agree to send 50,000 elite troops to participate in the battle."

"If we don't agree to some small requests, then we will break up and it will only benefit the Evil God camp."

"You can give in to the Evil God camp. In fact, we, the Zerg, also have a way out. If the alliance cannot defend this territory, you can follow us, the Zerg, to evacuate, and continue to develop in another place."

"The situation is not so bad that it makes people desperate."

Wu Qing said to the lords with a smile.

When everyone heard Wu Qing say that there was still a way out, and thought of what Meng said about the power behind the Zerg, they suddenly breathed a sigh of relief and felt better.

This is really a turn of events. Joining this alliance seems to have another way of survival.

"Excuse me, what are some small requests? I will definitely work hard to achieve them!"

The Rat Tribe Lord asked Wu Qing carefully. He was really afraid that Wu Qing would regret it if he was unhappy.

"Then the first requirement, I have already said, is to dispatch a total of 50,000 elite troops in at least three batches."

"We can refuse to accept the second requirement, a combat mission that clearly involves death, and we cannot be deprived of our right to command the troops on the battlefield."

"The third requirement is that when the battle losses of the combat troops reach 80%, we have the right to withdraw from the battlefield. Regardless of the outcome of the battle, the alliance shall not be held responsible."

"Go and report to the Tengu Clan. As long as you agree to these three conditions and agree that the Tengu Clan will no longer interfere in the affairs of the alliance after the war, we will agree to send troops."

Wu Qing listed the conditions one by one.

Wu Qing has actually been looking forward to this big battle. Even if the Tengu clan doesn't come over, the Zerg clan will take the initiative to participate.

It's easy to fish in troubled waters. As long as there is a battle to fight and the Zerg participates in it, they can reap benefits.

Now that the Tengu clan came to their door, Wu Qing had the opportunity to participate in the war openly, and of course he would not let it go.

If done well, this would be a good thing for Wu Qing.

"You go early and come back early. We will wait here for news about you."

"The territorial lords who do not want to join the alliance can leave now. We need to start discussing alliance affairs."

After Wu Qing was fierce, he issued another eviction order.

The Rat Lord took note of the conditions and left immediately.

Some of the lords who had not joined the alliance immediately stood up and left, while a few hesitated and decided to stay. At this last moment, they still chose to join the alliance.

Maybe what Wu Qing just said about the Zerg having a way out has tempted them.

Watching all the irrelevant people leave, he waved his hand and motioned for everyone to sit down.

"Wu Qing, since you agree to the Tengu clan's request to send troops, you must have your thoughts. Please tell everyone."

Meng said to Wu Qing.

It was a very serious problem to secretly agree to the requests of outsiders without communicating with everyone, but Meng trusted Wu Qing very much and knew that Wu Qing would never make his own decisions, and there must be a reason to convince everyone.

"Actually, I don't have any special ideas. I think that the stalemate with the Tengu clan at this time will be very detrimental to the development of the alliance. As long as the Tengu clan can agree to my request, our Daxia leader and the Zerg clan can shoulder the task of sending troops alone. "

Wu Qing said this with a smile, which was touching.

"Absolutely not!"

Meng flatly rejected Wu Qing's proposal.

In Meng's view, the original intention of forming the alliance was to gather everyone's strength to fight against foreign enemies, rather than to gather everyone to hide behind the Daxia Territory and the Zerg. Over time, the nature of the alliance has changed.

"I don't agree with it either! Isn't there anyone in White Wolf who is bullying me!?"

Unexpectedly, the second person to stand up and object was Bai Yan.

The lords of those small territories, whose territories had limited strength, were very moved by Wu Qing's proposal, but they absolutely did not dare to show it at this time.

"Yes! We don't agree either!"

"We need to send troops! Let's send troops together!"

"We will never shirk the responsibilities that are ours to share!"

"..."

With Meng and Bai Yan taking the lead, everyone acted like they were moved but would never agree.

When Wu Qing saw this situation, although he knew that most of the people were not sincere, the alliance had not yet been formally established, so the atmosphere was quite good now.

"I knew everyone would have opinions on my proposal, so I'll put it another way."

"Everyone knows that my Daxia Territory has just been established. It has thousands of people and is still building a place to live."

"In such a small territory like mine, the defense pressure is minimal, and the Zerg troops here are coming in a steady stream."

"The Zerg are the most warlike race, and they can't stand it if we let them just watch without fighting."

"Let's take a step back. The Zerg will send 90% of the troops. How about you all send 10% of the troops together?"

"I have a request. These ten percent of the troops must be truly elite troops, preferably long-range attack troops."

"The Zerg will definitely do their best to ensure their safety and allow these troops to return safely."

"If you are really feeling sorry for me, we are in the early stages of establishing the Great Xia Territory and are short of all kinds of supplies. You can give us some friendly support."

When Wu Qing said this, Meng also understood what he meant and stopped taking the lead in opposition.

Ten percent of 50,000 troops is 5,000 troops. It is still difficult for everyone to gather 5,000 elite troops for long-range attacks.
